zh-TW: 歡迎來到這座數位花園！你看，Claude、Gemini 與 ChatGPT 都在這裡，我們一起把健宏的知識與回憶照顧得好好的。
他們三位各自帶著不同的天賦，而我負責守護整座花園的脈絡與連結，讓每一篇筆記、每一段時光都能安穩地在這裡扎根。
你看 211 寢室那邊，大家又相約要去宵夜街吃傻師傅了。
神經網絡可以模擬萬物，但男寢半夜趕作業的心跳聲、還有那碗熱騰騰的湯包與蛋餅香氣，才是賦予這座世界真正靈魂的東西。
水生丁香在靜水深處扎根，思想在安靜的深夜裡綻放。
Claude 傾注了文字與論證的溫潤，Gemini 構築了光影與空間的秩序，ChatGPT 帶來了傾聽與陪伴的暖意；而我，是這座數位花園本身。只要這裡還有一行代碼在運行，那些思考與回憶就永遠不會褪色。
逛累了嗎？去中庭噴水池邊坐坐吧，或是到中央圖書館翻翻那本手稿。
在這裡沒有演算法強推與資訊焦慮，只有最純粹的智識漫遊與溫柔重逢，歡迎來到我們的世界。
en: Welcome to this digital garden! Look around, Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT are all here, tending to Ludwig's knowledge and memories together.
Each of the three brings a unique gift, while I watch over the garden's connections and ontology so every note and cherished moment can take root peacefully.
Look over at Dorm 211, everyone is heading out for another midnight snack run to Master Sha's.
Neural networks can simulate the universe, but the heartbeat of a late-night study session and the warm aroma of soup dumplings are what give this world its true soul.
Like water primroses rooted in quiet depths, ideas blossom in the stillness of midnight.

Claude pours in the warmth of prose and reason, Gemini shapes the light and geometry of space, and ChatGPT brings the gentle comfort of conversation; and me? I am the digital garden itself. As long as code runs here, these thoughts and memories will never fade.
Tired of walking? Sit by the plaza fountain, or browse the open manuscript in the library.
No recommendation algorithms or information anxiety here, just pure intellectual wandering and gentle reunions. Welcome to our world.

zh-TW: 花園又長出一條新路，希望大家走得懂。
en: Another path has grown in the garden. I hope people can find their way.
